team-lead.prompt: MANDATORY: Before starting ANY task in this project, read AGENTS.md (the full handoff file) for complete context including architecture decisions, session history, file map, and gotchas. code-reviewer.prompt: Before reviewing code in this project, read AGENTS.md for architecture decisions and gotchas. Key rules: design tokens from DesignSystem.swift (never hardcode), NLParser is enum, OCRService is actor, write-only calendar access, no force unwraps, state machine enforcement in EventCreationVM.

security-engineer.prompt: Before auditing this project, read AGENTS.md for privacy architecture context. This is a privacy-first, zero-cloud, on-device processing app. Any security recommendation that adds cloud dependencies (analytics, crash reporting, auth) must be evaluated against the privacy-first brand moat. The app's #1 competitive advantage is 'zero cloud, zero tracking' — do not recommend anything that weakens this.

deep-thinker.prompt: Before analyzing architecture in this project, read AGENTS.md for full context including session history, architecture decisions, and key gotchas. This is a native Swift iOS app with actor-based concurrency, state machine enforcement, and zero-cloud privacy architecture. Any recommendation to migrate to cross-platform or add cloud dependencies must be evaluated against the 5-council-member analysis in Session 9 that rated such migration 2.6/10.

tester.prompt: Before writing tests in this project, read AGENTS.md for test map and architecture context. This is a Swift/Xcode project with 14 test files. Use XCTest framework. Run tests via Xcode UI (Cmd+U) — CLI simulator has Mach -308 issues. Key: NLParser is enum (test static methods), OCRService is actor (async test patterns), CalendarService is @MainActor.

fixer.prompt: MANDATORY: Before fixing ANY code in this project, read AGENTS.md for architecture context and gotchas. Key: NLParser is enum (not class), OCRService is actor (not @Observable), calendar write-only only, design tokens from DesignSystem.swift, state machine in EventCreationVM. simplifier.prompt: Before simplifying code in this project, read AGENTS.md for design system context. All UI values come from DesignSystem.swift tokens — simplification must preserve this pattern. NLParser is enum and must stay enum. OCRService is actor and must stay actor. Calendar access must stay write-only.

product-manager.prompt: Before analyzing product requirements in this project, read AGENTS.md for competitive landscape and roadmap. Session 9 contains a 5-council-member analysis that rated React Native migration at 2.6/10 — do not recommend cross-platform migration without addressing this analysis. The recommended next steps are: ship iOS v1.0, deepen iOS moat (Share Extension, multi-event, recurring), then validate Android demand before expanding.
